/about.heading: A practical place to become a better pilot.
/about.copy: Lakes Area Aviation provides flight instruction, pilot services, aircraft management, and specialized training from bases in Minnesota, Colorado, and Arizona.

/accelerated-training.heading: Turn open calendar days into your next rating.
/accelerated-training.copy: Concentrated flight and ground training for pilots who arrive prepared and want every day to move the plan forward.

/admin.heading: Site appearance
/admin.copy: Sign in to change the accent color for every visitor.

/contact.heading: Build your training plan.
/contact.copy: Check what you already hold, choose what comes next, and see the published commitment before you call. All prices are estimates.

/fleet.heading: The airplanes you’ll actually fly.
/fleet.copy: Real photos, real tail numbers and the published rates for every airplane in the Lakes Area Aviation fleet.

/introductory-flights.heading: Take the pilot's seat for $100.
/introductory-flights.copy: An introductory flight is a hands-on first lesson and the clearest way to find out if flight training is right for you.

/local-training.heading: Train at your own pace, close to home.
/local-training.copy: While we specialize in accelerated, full-time training, we value our local students — one of our main goals is to grow a community of aviators.

/locations.heading: Three places to move your training forward.
/locations.copy: Contact the school to confirm which ratings, aircraft, and accelerated dates are available at each location.

/new-students.heading: Three steps to your first day.
/new-students.copy: We do all of our flight scheduling, billing, and more directly through Flight Schedule Pro.

/programs.heading: Choose the rating. Set the timeline.
/programs.copy: From your first solo to your first instructor student, build a focused training plan around the rating ahead.

/rates.heading: Every published rate, in one place.
/rates.copy: We strive to keep our aircraft costs low to make aviation accessible for everyone. All aircraft rates are wet and include fuel and insurance.

/scenic-flights.heading: See your world from the sky.
/scenic-flights.copy: Have you ever wondered what the Minnesota fall leaves look like from above, wanted to see the Rocky Mountains from the sky, or fly over your childhood landmarks?

/specialized-training.heading: Endorsements and courses beyond the ratings.
/specialized-training.copy: Along with our commitment to providing you the best training to fit your needs and schedule, we also offer specialized training in a variety of endorsements and ratings.

/student-success.heading: Progress measured in ratings earned.
/student-success.copy: Students come with different experience, preparation, and goals. Their stories show what focused training can make possible.

/team.heading: Reach your goals with our instructors.
/team.copy: A talented and dedicated team of flight instructors across airplane, instrument, multi-engine, and helicopter training.

/services.heading: Every rating, endorsement, and experience.
/services.copy: Whether you have zero flight hours or have three-hundred and are looking to finish a multi-engine commercial certificate, we are the school for you. We offer a wide variety of ratings, endorsements, and aviation experiences. All of our offerings are tailored to suit your individual needs.

/students.heading: Helping you reach your aviation goals in three great locations.
/students.copy: New to Lakes Area Aviation or already training with us — start here.

/programs/private-pilot.heading: Private Pilot
/programs/private-pilot.copy: Build the foundation for every rating that follows with concentrated ground and flight instruction.

/programs/instrument-rating.heading: Instrument Rating
/programs/instrument-rating.copy: Develop the skills and judgment to operate safely by reference to instruments.

/programs/commercial-single-engine.heading: Commercial Single-Engine
/programs/commercial-single-engine.copy: Advance your flying to commercial standards through concentrated maneuver, ground, and practical-test preparation.

/programs/commercial-multi-engine.heading: Commercial Multi-Engine
/programs/commercial-multi-engine.copy: Train for commercial multi-engine privileges in Lakes Area Aviation’s Piper Apache.

/programs/cfi-cfii.heading: CFI & CFII
/programs/cfi-cfii.copy: Choose an accelerated initial flight-instructor course, add instrument-instructor privileges, or plan both ratings back to back.

/programs/mei.heading: Multi-Engine Instructor
/programs/mei.copy: Add multi-engine instructor privileges in the Piper Apache through a short, concentrated course.

/programs/zero-to-hero.heading: Zero to Hero
/programs/zero-to-hero.copy: See the complete sequence Lakes Area Aviation publishes for progressing from no flight time toward professional flying.
